Suggest cutoff values for filter_occurrence_variant and filter_occurrence_read_count

Source: R/vtamR_fun.R
suggest_variant_readcount_cutoffs.Rd

Explore combinations of parameters for filter_occurrence_read_count and filter_occurrence_variant (followed by filter_min_replicate) in order to identify optimal filtering thresholds.

Usage

suggest_variant_readcount_cutoffs(
  read_count,
  outdir,
  known_occurrences = NULL,
  mock_composition = NULL,
  sampleinfo = NULL,
  habitat_proportion = 0.5,
  sep = ",",
  min_read_count_cutoff = 10,
  max_read_count_cutoff = 100,
  increment_read_count_cutoff = 5,
  min_variant_cutoff = 0.001,
  max_variant_cutoff = 0.01,
  increment_variant_cutoff = 0.001,
  by_replicate = FALSE,
  min_replicate_number = 1,
  quiet = T,
  log_file = NULL
)

Arguments

read_count

Data frame or CSV file with columns asv_id, sample, replicate, read_count, asv.

outdir

Character string naming the output directory.

known_occurrences

Data frame or file produced by classify_control_occurrences(), containing known true positives and false positives. Optional; if NULL, it is computed from mock_composition and sampleinfo.

mock_composition

Data frame or CSV file with columns sample, action (keep/tolerate), and asv.

sampleinfo

Data frame or CSV file with columns sample, sample_type (mock/negative/real), habitat, replicate (optional), and optional file metadata.

habitat_proportion

Numeric value between 0 and 1. Used to infer habitat-based artifacts when constructing known occurrences.

sep

Field separator character used in input and output CSV files.

min_read_count_cutoff

Positive integer specifying the minimum value tested for filter_occurrence_read_count().

max_read_count_cutoff

Positive integer specifying the maximum value tested for filter_occurrence_read_count().

increment_read_count_cutoff

Positive integer defining the step size between tested read count cutoff values.

min_variant_cutoff

Numeric value between 0 and 1 specifying the minimum value tested for filter_occurrence_variant().

max_variant_cutoff

Numeric value between 0 and 1 specifying the maximum value tested for filter_occurrence_variant().

increment_variant_cutoff

Numeric value between 0 and 1 defining the step size between tested variant cutoff values.

by_replicate

logical; argument passed to filter_occurrence_variant

quiet

logical; if TRUE, suppress informational messages and show only warnings or errors.

log_file

Character string specifying the path to the CSV log file. The path is resolved with the following priority:

  1. the log_file argument, if explicitly provided by the user;

  2. the vtamR.log_file option set with options(vtamR.log_file = ...), if set;

  3. "vtamR_log.csv" in the current working directory, used as a last resort if neither of the above is set.

To disable logging entirely, set log_file = NA.

`min_replicate_number()`

Positive integer specifying the minimum number of replicates for filter_min_replicate().

Value

Data frame with columns read_count_cutoff, variant_cutoff, FN, TP, and FP.

Details

For each parameter combination, the number of false negatives (FN), true positives (TP), and false positives (FP) is computed. Users are encouraged to select parameter settings that minimize both FN and FP.

If known_occurrences is not provided, it is constructed from read_count, mock_composition, sampleinfo, and habitat_proportion.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
suggest_variant_readcount_cutoffs(
  read_count_df,
  known_occurrences = "data/known_occurrences.csv",
  min_read_count_cutoff = 10,
  max_read_count_cutoff = 50,
  increment_read_count_cutoff = 10,
  min_variant_cutoff = 0.001,
  max_variant_cutoff = 0.005,
  increment_variant_cutoff = 0.001
)
} # }
